description: This header file defines utility functions and classes for security token management, Thunder plugin communication, and plugin activation within a WPEFramework-based project. It includes mechanisms for retrieving security tokens, checking Thunder security configuration, and managing plugin states.

classes.name: SecurityToken
classes.description: Provides static methods for retrieving and managing security tokens, including checking Thunder security configuration.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Encapsulates a unit of work to be dispatched, with different inheritance depending on the Thunder R4 version.

methods.name: getSecurityToken
methods.description: Retrieves the security token, caching it for subsequent calls, and checks if Thunder security is configured.

methods.name: writeCurlResponse
methods.description: Callback for writing curl response data into a string.

methods.name: isThunderSecurityConfigured
methods.description: Checks if Thunder security subsystem is configured by querying a local service.
